Hi <@U09BK0WKBQR>, I’ve opened the PR for #1131 (S3 same-second incremental cursor bug): <https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake/pull/1382|github.com/datazip-inc/olake/pull/1382>

The fix uses >= on the cursor and keeps track of keys already read in that second, so they aren’t synced twice. I also had to change the abstract incremental layer, because since #1302 a same-second sync was hitting the recovery path and skipping the read. The validation video is in the PR. I’ve also left an open question there about whether this needs a state version bump. Could you take a look when you get time? Thanks!
